instructions.A/B_Open: Empty or loaded: tape follows its own hinge. Disable/hide cassette mesh for empty opening.
instructions.A/B_LoadTape: Requires its own door open 35 degrees; local z .122 -> .041, starts above the open slot.
instructions.A/B_Close: Close after LoadTape completes. Own cassette remains parented to own hinge.
instructions.A/B_UnloadTape: Open first, then withdraw to above slot. Caller transfers the tape to player inventory.
instructions.A/B_PlaybackLoop: Only this deck reel/spindle rotations. 48-frame period (2 sec), endpoint at frame49 matches frame1 orientation.
instructions.Stop: Transient Press; never latch Stop. A stop does not release B record. Reel angles freeze at current value.
instructions.Press/Latch/Release: 13 mechanical keys each have 3 independent actions. Power is a separate press action.
instructions.Scope: Transform animations provided; audio, actual recording and game input require Unity integration.
instructions.VisibleKeys: Exactly five: B REC | A PLAY, A REW, A FF, A STOP. Latest user image supersedes B secondary physical controls. No keyboard labels or numbers. Hidden legacy pivots/clips remain compatible.
